Afterward, I paid thousands of dollars under that consent judgment, including an additional large payment to stop a sheriffs levy. Despite this, Rickel has demanded and attempted to collect large additional attorney and collection fees on top of that assessments only lien amount, treating the lien as if it secures a much larger, feeinflated debt that includes charges the lien itself says are not included. To this day, I still have not been provided with a complete, accurate XXXXside ledger from the XXXX or XXXX XXXX XXXX that would let me verify exactly which assessments, fees, and charges make up the balance Rickel is trying to collect. In my case, the law firm is demanding payment of large, recurring collection and attorney fees on top of a lien that is explicitly for assessments only and does not include those fees, and these charges go beyond what the XXXX governing documents clearly allow.
